identification: Cast iron two-division umbrella stand, Coalbrookdale-style, foliage stem, scallop shell drip tray on dolphin feet, H-77 cm. No marks or registration diamond visible in the 3 photos. Dolphin-footed shell-tray design was widely reproduced in the 20th century; likely a later casting, though the shape is Victorian in style. Cannot rule out a 19th century piece without seeing underside.

searches_tried: pipeline/comps.py: 'umbrella stand', 'coalbrookdale', 'cast iron stand', 'dolphin', 'victorian cast iron umbrella', 'walking stick stand'; work/comps.py: 'umbrella stand'. No resale (non-local) umbrella stand comps held; only one Leski Coalbrookdale stick stand. Local Armitage/Gowans cast iron stands mostly $25-$180, median about $55-$82, top $380.
chrome_hint: eBay AU sold + Terapeak: 'cast iron umbrella stand dolphin feet shell'; 'Coalbrookdale umbrella stand'; 'Victorian cast iron stick stand shell tray'. Also Invaluable/LiveAuctioneers sold: 'Coalbrookdale style umbrella stand dolphin' and Leski, Mossgreen/Theodore Bruce, Lawsons for Australian hammer prices. Check eBay AU BIN for 'reproduction cast iron umbrella stand dolphin' to see if retail repro sells for about $100-$200.
viewing_check: Turn it over and look at the underside and back of the tray and stem for a lozenge registration diamond, 'Coalbrookdale' or foundry name, casting numbers, and seam quality. Check weight and casting crispness (sharp detail and thick wall suggest old; light, soft, pitted detail and modern bolts suggest repro). Check the divider rings are original, not welded.
